description: This file defines the SharedBuffer class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, which facilitates inter-process shared memory communication with semaphore-based synchronization. It includes class declarations, member functions, and internal synchronization mechanisms, primarily for sharing data buffers between producer and consumer processes.

classes.name: SharedBuffer
classes.description: A class for sharing data buffers between processes with semaphore-based synchronization, supporting producer and consumer roles.

classes.name: SharedBuffer::Semaphore
classes.description: A nested class managing semaphore locking and unlocking, abstracting platform-specific semaphore handling.

methods.name: SharedBuffer(const TCHAR name[])
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the SharedBuffer as a consumer, attaching to existing shared memory.

methods.name: SharedBuffer(const TCHAR name[], const uint32_t mode, const uint32_t bufferSize, const uint16_t administrationSize)
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the SharedBuffer as a producer, setting up shared memory and synchronization primitives.

methods.name: RequestProduce
methods.description: Requests permission to produce data by locking the producer semaphore.

methods.name: Produced
methods.description: Signals that data production is complete and releases the consumer semaphore.

methods.name: RequestConsume
methods.description: Requests permission to consume data by locking the consumer semaphore.

methods.name: Consumed
methods.description: Signals that data consumption is complete and releases the producer semaphore.

methods.name: AdministrationBuffer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the administration buffer.

methods.name: BytesWritten
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes written to the buffer.

methods.name: User
methods.description: Sets or gets user permissions related to the shared buffer.

methods.name: Group
methods.description: Sets or gets group permissions related to the shared buffer.

methods.name: Permission
methods.description: Sets or gets permission modes for the shared buffer.
